_doc: Crop boxes for the business ads page (build_ads.py). box = [x0,y0,x1,y1] as fractions of pages/<issue>_p<page>.jpg. Keyed by issue + page + headline because article ids shift between rebuilds. 'check' = the note from the person who placed the box (2026-11-01). Corrections found while cropping were made in the extraction files: Hinton FJ 1827-10-12 is on p3, Shippard FJ 1828-05-30 on p6, the 1827-04-20 clothing ad is signed Daniel Peterson (not Asa B.), John Roberts is at 25 Currant-alley. 'philadelphia': false marks an ad from outside Philadelphia: kept in the database and here, but left off ads.html (Michiko, 2026-11-03: 'only have philadelphia ads').
